|notes=The Players Committee released the original-layout slip for Bad Feeling Have I on 30 May 2003. The published Set 5 editions are linked as [[Bad Feeling Have I (V) (Virtual Set 5: A Dark Time)|Original]] and [[Bad Feeling Have I (V) (Virtual Set 5: A Dark Time) (Errata)|Remastered (2006)]]. The first sheet was released 30 May 2003 and became tournament legal on 6 June. Both editions restrict lightsaber combat and retain the Vader deployment bonus and 2-Force duel search. The [https://web.archive.org/web/20090816063441id_/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/AR/AR1.7.1.pdf#page=10 period rulebook] uses the remastered wording to illustrate a search for a card with a particular property.

* [https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualCards5.pdf Virtual Set #5 revised sheet] (publisher index dates the edition 19 June 2003), res.starwarsccg.org, page 2, slip 28.
